book.name: MATEU
book.title: Eliywi no kuwaba lya Jesu Kilesite eli lina kun̄oliwa kwa MATEU

content: Jesu Yo Balisa Omulume ona Kutoma Embingwa
Cwale Jesu aba ana shetumukanga okutunda ba lilundu, enyangela sebeli imukon̄a.
Omulume ona kutomanga embingwa, sebeli oiya ni kukubama kwa yonyene ni kwamba nji, “Mbumu nji usinga kamotwesa okuni balisa.”
Jesu sebeli oolola elyoko lyaye ni kumulema ni kwamba nji, “Nisinga, woombole.” Mi ababo sebeli obalisiwa ku mbingwa yaye.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa yonyene nji, “Omone nji kautamba okwambela aanu. Kono ote oka kumonahaze kwa mupulisita mi okabe empo, eyo ana kwamba Mushe nji aanu apumene nji nubala.”
Jesu Yobalisa Omubika no Mukulu no Masole namu Loma
Cwale Jesu aba ana kwingena mu Kapenama, omukulu no masole sebeli oiya kwa yonyene okukumbela etuso ni kwamba nji,
“Mbumu, omubika wange kame atoine oweti no lun̄an̄ali, kame alanganine feela ku mundi.
Jesu sebeli omwambela nji, “Nikeyili nimubalise.”
Cwale omukulu no masole sebeli otambula nji, “Mbumu kanifanene okukuisana nji wiye mu ndoo yange. Kono waambe eliywi feela mi omubika wange mbabala.

Kame nilimukile eyi kakuli ni mene kame nili omunu woyo oli munji no maata no akulu ange, mi kame nikwite amasole awo nilaelela, aba nambela omunu nji ote, kame ata. Ku munjili kame nji oiye, kamea iya. Aba nambela omubika wange nji otenda ngeesi mi kame atenda.”
Cwale Jesu aba ana kuyupa ngeeso, sebeli okomoka mi sebeli wamba kwaanu ana mukon̄a nji, “Kame ni myambela nji, kana siwana kale omunu woyo okwite etumelo inene ngeesi muno mu Isilaele kanyi woyo.
Kame ni myambela nji ano kupula mba tundu ku upa ni ku wiko mi mba ikala bamweya ba mukiti ni Abulahama, Isaka ni Jakobo mu mubuso na kuwilu.
Kono kwaawo afanena okekala mu mubuso kame saka yumbelwe kundee ku uwi oko cwale sakukekale okulila ni kukweca amaeo.”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba ku mukulu no masole nji, “Ote ku ndoo yowe, mi mbutendeliwa eyo upumena.” Mi ababo omubika waye sebeli obala.
Jesu Yobalisa aanu no Kupula
Cwale Jesu aba ana kwingena mu ndoo ya Pitolosi, sebeli owana njemunwaye Pitolosi no mukati yo langanine mu mumbeta yokola elitomaapa.
Jesu sebeli omulema ku lyoko, ababo elitomaapa sebeli litunda, mi sebeli obala ni kwinguka oku mutendela eyi no kulya.
Mu nako no mangolwaa awo, aanu sebeli alita kwa Jesu anokupula asimandimona. Jesu sebeli otundisa emebo no kwiiba ni liywi ni kubalisa ana kukolanga oonje.
Esi neli okwiyateteta eyo ina kwambiwa kwa munuhi wa Nyambe Isaya nji, “Nalondo amayando etu onje, ni meeti etu.”
Outata oli mu Kukon̄a Jesu
Cwale Jesu aba ana kumona enyangela no aanu imutingulukile, sebeli olaela aiyetwa aye nji, “Mute mu linjaliya no liwate.”
Cwale akasita kale omwiyeti no mulawo sebeli oiya kwa yonyene ni kwamba nji, “Mwiyeti, mba niku kon̄o konje soute.”
Jesu sebeli omutambula nji, “Aluwawa akwite emina mi otuyunyi tukwite eiyaleto, kono Omwana no munu kakwite simba aba sasame omutwi waye.”
Omunjili omwiyetwa sebeli wamba nji, “Mbumu, mbani kukon̄o kono oweli nite ni kapumbeke sitange.”
Kono Jesu sebeli omutambula nji, “Muni kon̄e mi mulese aafu apumbeke aafu woo.”
Jesu Yo Ombota Amandinda
Cwale sebeli oingena mu sisepe na iyetwa aye sebele ata naye.
Ababo akatile sebeli kwiiya emebo no kunenenba ni mandinda sebeli atateka okwingena mu wato, kono Jesu kame nalangananga.
Aiyetwa sebeli ata kwa yonyene ni kumwingula nji, “Mbumu, otuyoyise kame tufa.”
Jesu sebeli otambula nji, “Anyi asi tumelo icana, iikene aba mucila?” Cwale sebeli oinguka ni kukanena emebo ni mandinda mi sebeli koondoka onene.
Aiyetwa aye sebeli akomoka onene mane ni kwamba nji, “Ngasibine aikalile woyo mulume? Simba emebo ni mandinda kame imu yupa!”
Jesu Yobalisa Alume Ayiili akwite Amandimona

Mi cwale Jesu aba ana kukeela mu naha no Magadaleni mu linjaliya no lisa, sebeli okuwana nalume ayiili asi mandimona akatundelele ku mabita. Alume awo kame ana kwikalanga ni mandimona no kucilisa onene nji mane kakwisa simba omunu ona kubitanga endila eyo.
Ababo sebeli akuwa ni kwamba nji, Siikene usaela okutende kwaaci, weene mwana Nyambe? Ninji kame uneyi mukutu yandisa enako eya kasikwana kale?
Bakatamba minwe kame kuna kwikala etingulube no kupula etilemine okulya.
Amandimona sebeli akumbela kwa Jesu nji, “Aba ututundisa utu citele muya mu tingulube.”
Jesu sebeli wamba ku mandimona nji, “Kamute! Mi ababo isitunda feela sebeli ikengena mu tingulube. Munyima omulaka wonje sebeli oshetumuka oka kuyumbela mu liwate ni kufela mu meyi.”
Alisana no tingulube sebeli aituka nikuta mu mulenen̄i, sebeli akambela aanu eyo ina tendahala yonje mane neyo yalume asimandimona.
Aanu namu mulenen̄i sebeli ata nuuka kuwana ni Jesu. Mi aba ana kumu mona sebeli amu kumbela nji atunde mu litunga lyoo.
